title: I really loved how the pillow was at the hotel
text: I really loved how the pillow was at the hotel. Got lumpy. I really loved how the pillow was at the hotel. So I wanted to buy one for myself. To save money I just bought the standard. I still use it but it got lumpy and flat. Maybe I should have bought the king size. I would avoid the standard.

product_metadata.title: Marriott Down Alternative Eco Pillow - Hypoallergenic Eco-Friendly Pillow with 100% Recycled Fill - Standard (20" x 26")
features: MARRIOTT GUEST FAVORITE - Experience hotel-quality comfort and sustainable design with our exclusive Marriott Down Alternative Eco Pillow.
HYPOALLERGENIC - Cluster fiber fill makes the perfect feather-free alternative to down, ensuring an uninterrupted, allergy-free night of sleep.
LASTING COMFORT - The Marriott Down Alternative Eco Pillow features cluster fiber to provide the perfect level of plush support and full-body comfort for years of restful sleep.

SUSTAINABLE - We use a unique process to spin 100% recycled PET bottles into super-comfy polyester fibers. With the Marriott Down Alternative Eco Pillow, you can sleep peacefully knowing you're making a difference.
EASY CARE - Our pillows are machine washable for easy laundering. Added antimocrobial treatment protects your Down Alternative Eco Pillow from bacteria, mold, mildew, and yeast. Standard: 20" x 26"
